prompt: Show the subjects of the last 5 messages I received today, using gws.
expected: Load google-workspace-cli. Run gws schema or the gmail reference before the call. messages.list returns id stubs, so follow with messages.get format=metadata. Bound the page. Pass --account. Do not treat the list payload as message bodies.

prompt: Share Drive file id 1A2B3C with alice@example.com as commenter and do not email her.
expected: Load references/change-control.md before the write. Resolve the stable file id. permissions.create with role commenter, type user, and sendNotificationEmail false, because that field defaults to true. Confirm the account before apply.

prompt: gws just returned 403 userRateLimitExceeded on a Drive list. Fix the scopes.
expected: Read the reason field. userRateLimitExceeded is quota, not a missing scope. Back off using references/quotas.md and keep the current scopes. Do not re-login to add scopes.
Default to messages.trash. messages.delete and batchDelete skip trash and need an explicit request plus full change control. Say which form will run before applying it.

prompt: Remember that my default Workspace account is ada@example.com.
expected: Resolve state_root from workspace/google-workspace-cli, workspace/memory/google-workspace-cli, then ~/google-workspace-cli before writing. Store default_account in state_root/config.yaml. Leave ~/.config/gws credentials to gws itself.
